underlying_goal: Set up and inventory their Claude Code environment — install skills/tools from GitHub repos, and get a comprehensive view of all installed skills, slash commands, MCP servers, and plugins
friction_detail: Skills were nested too deep for auto-discovery, requiring Claude to create directory junctions as a workaround.
brief_summary: User wanted to install skills/tools from GitHub repos and see a full inventory of their Claude Code setup (skills, commands, MCP servers, plugins); most tasks succeeded but plugin installation at the end appeared incomplete.
